<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ComplianceAudit" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditReady" name="Ready for external audit"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditFindings" name="Audit findings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FinalAuditReady" name="Ready for final audit"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfficialDocuments" name="Official documents"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company compliance audit preparation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditScheduled" name="Compliance audit scheduled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="ThrowEvent_AuditReady" name="Ready for external audit">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AuditReady" messageRef="Message_AuditReady"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_AuditFindings" name="Receive audit findings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AuditFindings" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CorrectGaps" name="Make necessary corrections or improvements"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="ThrowEvent_FinalAuditReady" name="Ready for final audit">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FinalAuditReady" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditReady"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_OfficialDocuments" name="Receive official documents">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OfficialDocuments" messageRef="Message_OfficialDocuments"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DocumentsIssued" name="Official documents issued"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Start_Prepare" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditScheduled" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Prepare_Evidence" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Evidence_SelfAssessment" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Task_ConductSelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_SelfAssessment_Ready" sourceRef="Task_ConductSelfAssessment" targetRef="ThrowEvent_AuditReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Ready_Findings" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_AuditReady" targetRef="CatchEvent_AuditFindings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Findings_Correct" sourceRef="CatchEvent_AuditFindings" targetRef="Task_CorrectGaps"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Correct_FinalReady" sourceRef="Task_CorrectGaps" targetRef="ThrowEvent_FinalAuditReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_FinalReady_Documents" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_FinalAuditReady" targetRef="CatchEvent_OfficialDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Documents_End" sourceRef="CatchEvent_OfficialDocuments" targetRef="EndEvent_DocumentsIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ExternalAuditors" name="External audit and certification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ExternalAudit" name="External audit begins">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExternalAudit" messageRef="Message_AuditReady"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review company processes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyGaps" name="Identify gaps or issues"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="ThrowEvent_AuditFindings" name="Send audit findings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SendFindings" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_FinalAuditReady" name="Receive final audit readiness">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveFinalReady" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditReady"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductFinalAudit" name="Conduct final audit"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet" name="Are all criteria met?" default="Flow_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueDocuments" name="Issue official documents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CertificationDocuments" name="Certification documents issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UnspecifiedOutcome" name="Outcome not specified"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_Start_Review" sourceRef="StartEvent_ExternalAudit" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_Review_Identify" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Task_IdentifyGaps"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_Identify_Findings" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyGaps" targetRef="ThrowEvent_AuditFindings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_Findings_FinalReady" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_AuditFindings" targetRef="CatchEvent_FinalAuditReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_FinalReady_FinalAudit" sourceRef="CatchEvent_FinalAuditReady" targetRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_FinalAudit_Criteria" sourceRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaMet_Award" name="All criteria met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allCriteriaMet</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaNotMet" name="Criteria not met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="EndEvent_UnspecifiedOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Award_Issue" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="EndEvent_CertificationDocuments"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComplianceAudit">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ExternalAuditors" name="External auditors" processRef="Process_ExternalAuditors"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AuditReady" name="Audit readiness" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_AuditReady" targetRef="StartEvent_ExternalAudit" messageRef="Message_AuditReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AuditFindings" name="Audit findings" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_AuditFindings" targetRef="CatchEvent_AuditFindings" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalAuditReady" name="Final audit readiness" sourceRef="ThrowEvent_FinalAuditReady" targetRef="CatchEvent_FinalAuditReady" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OfficialDocuments" name="Official documents" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="CatchEvent_OfficialDocuments" messageRef="Message_OfficialDocuments"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
